## Change and reason

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and link the source commit/PR.

## Evidence and status

- Change record:
- Source repository, branch and immutable commit (or configuration revision):
- Tests actually run and results:
- Deployment status and evidence (or not deployed / not applicable):
- Remaining limitations and next action:

## Documentation checks

- [ ] Current reference updated, or reason no update is needed given.
- [ ] Dated change record added/updated without erasing prior history.
- [ ] Mintlify validation and link checks pass, or existing failures are identified.
- [ ] No credentials, private customer data or raw operational logs included.
- [ ] Ready for human review; no auto-merge or automatic publication enabled.
